mechanics.claim: Fears nearby enemy minions and monsters for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually slowed by up to 99% over the duration.
mechanics.quote: fearing nearby enemy {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually {{tip|slow|slowed}} by up to 99% over the duration

mechanics.claim: Gains bonus movement speed that decays over time, lasting until World Ender ends, not a flat duration.
mechanics.quote: He also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays by 10% of the '''current bonus''' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, lasting until ''World Ender'' has ended.

mechanics.claim: Killing an enemy champion extends World Ender's duration by 5 seconds (up to its original length) and re-triggers the unleash effect (refreshing speed/tint).
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Aatrox''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}}, he extends the duration by 5 seconds, up to its original length, and becomes unleashed again.

mechanics.claim: During World Ender, Aatrox gains bonus attack damage, is ghosted, and receives increased self-healing from all sources.
mechanics.quote: During ''World Ender'', '''Aatrox''' gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, has 5% increased [[size]], is {{tip|ghosted}}, and receives increased {{tip|heal|self-healing}} from all sources.

mechanics.claim: Aatrox can move during World Ender's cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''''Aatrox''' can move during World Ender's cast time.''

mechanics.claim: World Ender persists through resurrection effects, and its healing amplification applies to the health gained by resurrecting.
mechanics.quote:
''World Ender'' persists through {{tip|resurrection}} effects.
** ''World Ender's'' healing amplification applies to the health gained by resurrecting.

mechanics.claim: Recasting World Ender while it is still active removes the timer on the resource bar (bug), affecting duration tracking display only.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''World Ender'' while it is still active removes the timer on the resource bar. {{bug}}

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts on cast.
